name: Infrastructure problems
description: Browser, Grid or network failed: not a result about the application
messageRegex: (?s).*(SessionNotCreated|NoSuchSession|UnreachableBrowser|Connection refused|connection reset|chrome not reachable|Could not start a new session).*

name: Application too slow or UI changed (wait timeouts)
description: An explicit wait expired: the expected state never appeared

name: Product defects
description: An assertion failed: the application did not behave as expected

name: Test defects
description: The test or framework itself threw an unexpected exception
